text:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up — AWS & GCP partner teams asked for a single ref-arch + TF modules that support both x86 and arm64 (Graviton/Ampere). Need to sync on compatibility tests, sample images, and marketplace packaging. Who can own module matrix? :eyes:

michael-eng: I can take module work for AWS provider. Key gotcha: x86 vs arm64 AMI naming and packaging for container images. We should publish two builder images and tag them with arch. Example provider snippet:
```provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" }
resource "aws_instance" "test" { ami = var.ami_map[var.arch] }```

sarah-terraform: I'll own the Terraform test harness (Terratest). Plan: generate matrix tests for arch x region x instance family. Use GH Actions with matrix. Need sample infra outputs we can smoke test (LB DNS, instance health).

raj-cloud: GCP partner asks for deployment variants: VM + container marketplace listing. Need validated startup script for arm64 images and to confirm arm64 zone availability. I'll check quota and share region list.

anna-partnerships: Timeline — partner launch ~4 weeks. Can we get a "smoke-certified" module in 2 weeks? :calendar:

michael-eng: 2 weeks is tight but doable if we scope to a single reference topology (NLB/ALB + autoscaling + model container). I'll prototype an AMI map + user_data that detects arch and pulls the right image tag. Example user-data: ```#!/bin/bash
ARCH=$(uname -m)
if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/runner:arm64-latest; else docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/runner:amd64-latest; fi```

sarah-terraform: I'll add GH Actions matrix: arch: [x86_64, arm64], provider: [aws, gcp], run: [smoke]. Tests will assert instance reachable, container responding on /health, and model load logs. Will wire secrets via repo secrets and ephemeral creds for partner CI.

raj-cloud: I'll coordinate with partner SRE to reserve test quota in us-west-2 and europe-west1 and open a ticket for marketplace packaging knobs (license text, icons, install script). I'll also sketch a marketplace compatibility table (region / arch / image type).

deploy-bot: CI workflow triggered: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ref-arch-terraform/actions — job queued :rocket:

anna-partnerships: Action items recap:
- michael-eng = AWS module + AMI map + prototype user-data
- sarah-terraform = CI matrix + terratest smoke suite
- raj-cloud = partner quota + marketplace packaging checklist + region/arch table
I'll draft partner quickstart (one-pager + troubleshooting matrix). Ping me with blockers by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
